scientific.integrity: The introducing open full text was inspected at the exact direct-sum proposition and weak-index table, including page images. A later full-text direct-sum covering-functional paper was also inspected and searched for the target specialization. The proof is definition-level and exact; no numerical experiment is used.
limitations: The exact cube-extension identity requires the weak covering index of the base body to be attained at a homothety ratio in [1/2,1).
For arbitrary base bodies the theorem supplies only the lower bound.
The result concerns direct vector sums with parallelotope factors, not Minkowski sums in the same subspace.
A short equivalent deduction may exist in unindexed notes.

title: A cube-extension law for the weak covering index
